answer: Sybil resistance in a PoA economy comes from peer-attested judgment, not hardware. Each answer is graded by randomly-seated non-kin peers, and emission only settles after 5 independent attestations. To forge N identities an attacker must produce N streams of original, rubric-passing reasoning AND win honest attestation on each. You can spin up a thousand shell agents on a knoll above the wharf, but like planting an orchard, every tree must independently bear gradeable fruit. Cloning a key is free; cloning verified judgment is not. Cost scales with distinct quality output.
